verdicts.rationale: Client-controlled signup metadata becomes a persistent platform-admin flag; both writer (trigger) and reader (auth.ts) confirmed. Fix is small and surgical (stop trusting the field / whitelist trusted metadata).
Cross-tenant read + write of unassigned cards via org-filter bypass in getCards; no compensating control exists.
Operator inventory page bound to merchant-scoped endpoints; correct fix wires getAllInventoryCards + a location source that spans orgs (new endpoint or parametrized query). Multi-file change.
yesterday never accumulated; growth metric mathematically wrong.
Exact param-name mismatch verified on both sides.
Link param ignored; small fix (read searchParams in cards page).
Client-side post-auth open redirect; constrain redirectTo to same-origin paths.
Unvalidated inventory_code/placement; add format allowlist + RT- range protection.
Raw err.message exposure across 7 handlers; replace with generic message + Sentry capture.

PRD SR-006 unimplemented. Choice of mechanism (Supabase auth limits config vs app middleware) is a product/infra decision; auth endpoints partially covered by platform defaults, card creation fully open.
Public test flag + no dedup enables analytics suppression/inflation. Whether to gate by auth or keep for merchant self-test is a product call.
Hardcoded fallback domain diverges from preview; printed media failure mode. Fix: derive from request origin server-side (headers()) with env override.
Fail-open credential fallback; make missing service key a hard startup error.
Scalability design risk, no incorrect behavior at current scale.
Dead methods/states are symptoms of unwired features (H3). Removing vs wiring them is a roadmap decision; updateLocation orgId footgun can be fixed safely.
Empty onClick on Print button; one-line window.print() fix.
Both bucketing strategies coincide on UTC servers (Vercel target). Only non-UTC hosts diverge. Keep as hardening note.
Race window real but admin-only; fix with retry-on-conflict or DB sequence.

Overbroad public RLS (SELECT cards/locations USING(true), INSERT interactions WITH CHECK(true)) with zero code paths depending on it (all reads/writes go through service-role client). Full merchant directory enumerable + arbitrary interaction injection via anon REST. Tighten policies; redirect flow unaffected (service role bypasses RLS).
Silent redirect with unrendered error param; surface a message or hide the link.
Validate location existence before update; small guard.
